## Date Reduction Formula (GG33 System)

Add all digits of the target date, reduce to single digit. Preserve master numbers: 11, 22, 33.

**Example:** 02/19/26 → 0+2+1+9+2+6 = 20 → 2+0 = **2 (11/2)**
